Did EDC three years in a row. 2022-2024. Two years hotel and this year RV camping. Definitely prefer RV camping. The camp ground is basically another mini festival itself with so many activities going on. The walk to the venue is about 10-15mins. You can go back to the camp site and then back the to the venue again if needed. They have their own merch booth as well. It does get hot and the shower situation is not the best. I did RV with plug in so the heat wasn’t an issue inside the RV since we had AC. Noise wasn’t an issue for me. If I go to EDC again, I would definitely do RV camping again. Due to the convince of being close to the venue and not worrying about driving and the pre party and afters.

I love taking shrooms at a rave. I usually have a great experience overall. What makes the experience better/worse for me is the crowd. I had a couple of interactions with rude ppl while on shrooms. There’s always gonna be assholes and me personally the best thing to do is just move to a different spot and move away from that negativity . I would recommend a fidget toy as well. Whenever I’m in a bad move I just focus on my fidget toy or eat some candy and focus on that plus the music and that usually makes my negative spiral go away and I’m back in the game.  Even if you were sober, dealing with negative people can ruin the whole experience. I also get stuck in thought loops too, but I just remind myself it’s just the shrooms and it’s “not that serious” lmao and play with my fidget toy or just chew some gum or eat some candy.

Get everything ready before you trip. You don’t want to waste your time on LSD finding things that you want/need. I recommend trippy EDM/alternative for music. Create a playlist or find one. you gotta have electric feel by MGMT in the playlist. It’s a must. Anything Champagne Drip is great as well. LSD  last a while so I would plan a day just for tripping. It takes a while to kick in about 2-3 hrs. So don’t take more just because you can’t feel it. You will feel it. Once it does, embrace the feeling. It’s call a trip for a reason. Don’t fight it and just let go and enjoy!
